artifacts.title: AI RMF Core, rasterized OCR fixture from NIST AI 100-1
artifacts.modification: Physical original PDF page 25 rendered at 200 dpi, converted to RGB, and placed as the only image on a one-page letter-size PDF with no text layer. This is a lab-created scan-like derivative, not an authentic historical scan. The visible source page was not rewritten or cropped.

limitations: Only two selected English pages are exercised; this is not a representative document dataset or OCR evaluation.
The OCR input is a clean rasterized derivative. It does not model skew, handwriting, damaged scans or difficult layout.
Public source availability does not bypass the demo's artificial tenant and role grants.
A cited public document does not establish NIST endorsement, compliance or certification.
